args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club — Tuesdays at 7 PM
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I’d like to invite you to our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library. Right now the group is reading mystery novels.

We’d love to have you join us — please let me know if you can make it.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Saturday Farmers Market at the Town Square
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to invite you to the Saturday morning farmers market at the town square. It runs from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM and features great fresh produce and local vendors. It’s a lovely way to spend the morning—hope you can stop by!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery Downtown
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown. Their sourdough bread is incredible — they bake fresh every morning at 6 AM. If you enjoy a great, crusty loaf with lots of flavor, it’s definitely worth a visit.

Hope you get a chance to try it!

Best,
